_meta.role: Single source of truth for negative prompts. Every skill reads negatives from this file, never from style_lock.json.
_meta.edit_policy: Read-only for every skill and agent. Edit only when the user explicitly asks. `negative` must stay identical to shared/style_lock.json -> negative; update both files together.

changelog.change: Initial: `negative` copied verbatim from style_lock.json; added append_by_type for type-specific exclusions.

Applied Option A from reference analysis (user-approved): `negative` synced with style_lock v0.2.0; character adds chibi/super deformed; weapon swaps 'multiple weapons' for 'weapon pile' so the double-exposure echo is allowed; scene drops 'character' so incidental creatures are allowed and adds 'human figure'.
新增過度泛光、過曝高光、過量裝飾星芒與非發光表面光邊的排除詞；魔法改排除輪廓不清，允許柔和照明；全域 negative 與 style lock 同步。
依使用者要求新增武器專用排除詞：雙重曝光殘影、重複武器剪影與背景放大武器影子。
依使用者要求允許人物持握武器；移除武器專用 person、character、hands、hand holding weapon、wielder 排除詞，保留武器主體與背景殘影排除規則。

negative: extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed hands, bad anatomy, distorted face, blurry subject, low detail, jpeg artifacts, text, letters, watermark, signature, UI, card frame, border, cluttered background, multiple characters, awkward cropping, cut-off head, dull muted colors, desaturated, muddy colors, photorealistic, 3d render, excessive bloom, blown-out highlights, excessive decorative sparkles, glowing outlines on non-emissive surfaces

append_by_type.weapon: weapon pile, weapon rack, double-exposure weapon echo, duplicate weapon silhouette, oversized weapon shadow in the background
append_by_type.scene: people, crowd, human figure, close-up portrait, flat empty background
append_by_type.magic: character portrait focus, face close-up, indistinct effect silhouette
